title: HeadsUp! High-Fidelity Portrait Image Super-Resolution

training_stages.trainable_modules: LoRA on the SD 2.1 VAE encoder and denoiser

data_construction: PortraitSR-4K candidates come from LAION2B, Photo Concept Bucket and PD12M; minimum 3840x2160, aspect ratio 0.6-1.6, Q-Align quality/aesthetic filtering, inter-eye distance >=64 px, CVLFace pair similarity >=0.65. The paper reports 30K images, 27K train/3K test, 163K training reference pairs and 190 test pairs.
loss_weights: lambda_fid=1, lambda_face_LPIPS=0.8, lambda_id=4; remaining weights follow OSEDiff
optimizer_hyperparameters: AdamW, learning rate 5e-5, LoRA rank 4, 1024x1024, reference dropout 0.2, 8xA100

title: AuthFace: Towards Authentic Blind Face Restoration with Face-oriented Generative Diffusion Prior

training_stages.frozen_modules: not separately stated in the extracted main text
training_stages.objective: masked noise reconstruction plus negative-guidance loss
noise MSE plus time-aware latent facial feature loss

data_construction: The 1.5K HQ portraits are manually curated and enriched with semantic and photography-oriented tags. FFHQ is resized from 1024x1024 to 512x512 for restoration training.
degradation: synthetic blind face degradation used for the FFHQ restoration pairs; exact parameter ranges should be read from the paper/code before reproduction
loss_weights: L_stage1 = L_mask + lambda_cfg L_cfg; L_stage2 = L_noise + L_facial; numeric weights are not stated in the extracted implementation paragraph
optimizer_hyperparameters: AdamW; Stage I lr 5e-7, batch 96, 20K iterations, 1024x1024; Stage II lr 2e-5, batch 48, 512x512; 4xA100

title: TIGER: Taming Identity, Geometry, and Generative Priors for High-Quality Face Video Restoration

training_stages.objective: lambda1 latent MSE + lambda2 LPIPS + lambda3 pixel MSE

training_stages.frozen_modules: VAE decoder is frozen to reduce mode-collapse risk
training_stages.objective: Stage II losses plus lambda4 adversarial loss

data_construction: Video filtering uses motion amplitude, face clarity and face proportion. The paper retains 28,491 clips. References are sampled from frames and background-removed. Stage I uses all three training sources; Stages II-III use filtered VFHQ. The real benchmark contains 100 VoxCeleb2 videos with same-identity cross-scene reference photos.
degradation: controllable synthetic video degradation; the paper additionally uses identity and geometry condition dropout for missing-prior robustness
loss_weights: The adopted setting shown in the paper ablation is lambda1=1.0, lambda2=2.0, lambda3=10.0, lambda4=0.2; the table also documents the identity-realism trade-off under alternative settings.
optimizer_hyperparameters: Wan2.1-Fun-1.3B; DiT LoRA rank 384; VAE decoder full fine-tuning; Adam lr 1e-4; 10 epochs, 8 GPUs, batch 8, 512x512. Stage I uses 81-frame clips, Stages II-III use 21-frame clips. Identity and geometry streams receive stochastic conditional dropout.

title: RestorerID: Towards Tuning-Free Face Restoration with ID Preservation

training_stages.objective: conditional diffusion noise MSE with LQ/reference dropout

data_construction: Base restoration uses FFHQ and VGGFace2. FIR-Adapter training selects 9,384 identities from VGGFace2 and Celeb-Ref, each with 5-40 images, followed by dataset cleaning.
degradation: second-order blur-resize-noise-JPEG synthesis; sRGB is converted through an ISP model to RAW space before adding camera-like noise
loss_weights: ID-Scale=0.75 in Stage II; LQ and reference conditions are randomly dropped for classifier-free guidance
optimizer_hyperparameters: AdamW, lr 5e-5, batch 16, 512x512, 2xNVIDIA GPUs; 60K base-model iterations + 30K FIR-Adapter iterations

title: IConFace: Fine-Grained Identity Conditioning for Reference-Aware Face Restoration

training_stages.trainable_modules: rank-16 LoRA on FLUX.2 transformer plus identity projector and degraded-structure modules
training_stages.frozen_modules: VAE encoder, VAE decoder, text encoder and AdaFace identity model
training_stages.objective: flow matching plus reference and target identity cosine losses

data_construction: Identity-level official split and reference mappings are preserved. Clean targets are resized/center-cropped to 512x512; references are sampled independently and are not synthetically degraded. Training samples 0/1/2/3 references with probabilities 30/30/20/20.
degradation: online 50% BSRGAN and 50% Real-ESRGAN; degradation strength buckets 0-3/4-8/9-16 sampled with probabilities 0.5/0.3/0.2
loss_weights: identity targets use stop-gradient; high-noise timesteps receive lower identity-supervision weight
optimizer_hyperparameters: 4 GPUs, bf16, per-device batch 1, gradient accumulation 4, global batch 16, 12 epochs, AdamW weight decay 1e-4, 100-step warmup plus cosine decay; base lr 1e-5, LoRA lr 5e-7, identity-projector lr 3e-5

title: OSDFace: One-Step Diffusion Model for Face Restoration

training_stages.trainable_modules: HQ/LQ VQ dictionaries and association module
training_stages.objective: L1 + perceptual + adversarial + VQ + HQ/LQ association cross entropy

training_stages.trainable_modules: one-step diffusion restoration modules and rank-16 U-Net LoRA
training_stages.objective: one-step restoration, facial identity loss and GAN distribution guidance

data_sources: FFHQ and synthetic LQ/HQ face pairs described by the paper
data_construction: HQ and LQ visual dictionaries are learned separately, then associated with a cross-entropy objective whose coefficient is gradually enabled.
degradation: blind face degradation described in the paper training setup
loss_weights: lambda_per=1.0, lambda_dis=0.8, VQ beta=0.25; association coefficient ramps from 0 to 1
optimizer_hyperparameters: Stage I Adam lr 1.44e-4, batch 32; HQ dictionary 50 epochs, LQ dictionary 10 epochs, association 10 epochs, 8xA800. Stage II AdamW lr 1e-4, batch 2, U-Net LoRA rank 16.

title: HDRFace: Rethinking Face Restoration with High-Dimensional Representation

training_stages.trainable_modules: SDFM conditioning path; SD 2.1 uses LoRA, Qwen-Image is fully fine-tuned
training_stages.objective: GAN realism + ArcFace identity + perceptual + reconstruction

data_construction: FFHQ is resized to 512x512 and degraded with the VQFR degradation pipeline.
loss_weights: L_total = lambda_G L_G + lambda_ID L_ID + lambda_per L_per + lambda_rec L_rec; use paper/code for numeric weights
optimizer_hyperparameters: SD 2.1: DINOv3-L, LoRA rank/alpha 16, 2xA100, batch 2, 100K iterations. Qwen-Image: full fine-tuning, batch 1, 10K iterations, 1xA100.

title: FADRA: Frequency-Aware Diffusion with Residual Adaptation for Video Face Restoration

training_stages.trainable_modules: LoRA and repeated residual adaptation head on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B
training_stages.objective: flow matching plus frequency-aware latent loss

data_construction: Quality filtering retains 15,127 high-quality clips. Degradation parameters are shared within a clip to preserve temporal consistency.
degradation: resize ratio U(1,8), Gaussian blur kernel 3-25 with sigma U(1.5,6), noise and compression
loss_terms: 8x8 latent DCT frequency-aware loss weighted by HVS/JPEG quantization tables
loss_weights: L = L_FM + L_freq; detailed coefficient should be taken from the released configuration

title: SVFR: A Unified Framework for Generalized Video Face Restoration

training_stages.trainable_modules: diffusion U-Net, task embedding, Unified Latent Regularization module and landmark predictor
training_stages.objective: diffusion noise MSE + cross-task latent regularization + landmark prior

data_construction: ARNIQA filtering produces 20K high-quality clips. Blind restoration, colorization and inpainting variants are generated from common video sources.
degradation: blur, noise, resize and video compression CRF for restoration; grayscale conversion for colorization; brush masks for inpainting
loss_weights: L = L_noise + lambda1 L_ULR + lambda2 L_prior; the ablation reports lambda1=0.01
optimizer_hyperparameters: joint multi-task training on a Stable Video Diffusion backbone; consult the original config for full optimizer settings

title: CFRNet: Cycle-Consistent Fixed-Point Training for Real-Time Blind Face Restoration on Consumer Embedded NPUs

training_stages.frozen_modules: pretrained VGG-19 and ArcFace supervision networks
training_stages.objective: progressive cycle supervision + idempotence + re-degradation cycle + global/local adversarial + component style + identity

data_construction: FFHQ is resized to 256x256 with a fixed 90/5/5 identity-image split reported as 63K/3.5K/3.5K.
degradation: GFPGAN-style Gaussian blur, downsampling, Gaussian noise and JPEG compression
loss_weights: lambda_per=1, lambda_fp=0.5, lambda_cyc=0.5, lambda_adv=0.1, lambda_loc=1, lambda_fs=1, lambda_id=10
optimizer_hyperparameters: lambda_fp ramps 0->0.5 during first 100K iterations; GAN warmup 5K then adversarial/component ramp 5K; Adam lr 2e-4, batch 16, 32 epochs plus lr x0.25 fine-tuning

title: Latent Posterior-Mean Rectified Flow for Higher-Fidelity Perceptual Face Restoration

training_stages.objective: L1 plus perceptual reconstruction and weak KL regularization

data_construction: LSDIR is cropped to 512x512 and filtered with Q-Align >=3.5; FFHQ is resized to 512x512. Sim-VAE uses filtered LSDIR plus the first 10K FFHQ images.
degradation: blind face degradation used by the PMRF training protocol
loss_weights: lambda_reg=1e-6; the strong VAE is trained without an adversarial loss
optimizer_hyperparameters: Sim-VAE: 150K iterations, batch 64, Adam, 500-step warmup at 1e-5, cosine lr 1e-4->1e-6. Flow model: FFHQ, 400K iterations, batch 64.
